title: A Cipher for the Letter
author: Tamsin Thornbury
blurb: Mirabel Delacroix, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
